archetypes.name: dyn-implement-flow
archetypes.rationale: Compressed orchestration prose can accidentally shift routing semantics.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changes to skills/implement/SKILL.md for semantic drift in /implement control flow. Focus on Preflight, Step 2 dispatcher routing, Step 5 review handling, Step 8 ship state routing, and Step 16-18 final-summary and cleanup behavior. Verify that required tokens remain exact and that shortened prose still preserves the original workflow guarantees. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-prompt-load
archetypes.rationale: This change targets an always-loaded prompt surface with many pinned tests.
archetypes.prompt_body: Assess whether the prose compression reduces prompt load without removing load-bearing duplication. Pay special attention to anti-halt, no-polling, post-merge, and recovery-boundary reminders. Flag any shortened passage that could cause an orchestrator to stop early or choose the wrong branch. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
